blurb: SKYIN offers tailored wildlife safaris, cultural immersions with indigenous tribes, and adventure activities in Kenya and Uganda. Guests can experience guided game drives, hot air balloon rides, night drives, great ape trekking, and cultural visits. Accommodations range from luxury tented camps to homestays with vetted local families.
